summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of Treesh 3.0 new features (synced lyrics, Now Playing redesign, queue management, share functionality, artist enrichment) and regression testing. All backend APIs (11/11) and frontend features passed successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/catalog/lyrics/{song_id} returns synced lyrics (60 lines for 'chelly-banqz-shake-it-some-mo')
Backend: GET /api/catalog/lyrics/{song_id} returns synced=false and empty lyrics for songs without lyrics
Backend: GET /api/catalog/lyrics/{unknown} returns 404
Backend: GET /api/catalog/songs returns 57 songs without 'lyrics' field (lean response)
Backend: GET /api/catalog/artists/3 returns SAVIONCE with cashapp='SAVIONCE' and bio (179 chars)
Backend: GET /api/catalog/genres returns 11 genres
Backend: GET /api/catalog/artists returns 12 artists
Backend: GET /api/catalog/songs?q=Shake returns search results
Backend: GET /api/catalog/songs?genre={genre} filters by genre
Backend: POST /api/favorites/toggle works (on/off)
Backend: Playlists CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Frontend: Now Playing view opens with big artwork, ambient gradient, seek slider, play/pause/prev/next/shuffle/repeat buttons
Frontend: Action bar buttons present (like/lyrics/queue/add/share)
Frontend: Lyrics view displays 60 synced lyric lines
Frontend: Clicking lyric line seeks to that timestamp
Frontend: Lyrics toggle back to artwork works
Frontend: Queue drawer opens, lists items, remove button works, close button works
Frontend: Share button triggers clipboard fallback with 'Link copied' toast
Frontend: Deep link /?song=chelly-banqz-shake-it-some-mo auto-opens Now Playing and plays song
Frontend: Artist detail page shows SAVIONCE bio (179 chars)
Frontend: Artist detail page shows Cash App link (https://cash.app/$SAVIONCE)
Frontend: Artist Play All button works
Frontend: Artist Shuffle button works
Frontend: Playlist creation works
Frontend: Playlist share button triggers clipboard with toast
Frontend: Library search works
Frontend: Genre chips filter works
Frontend: Favorites toggle works
Frontend: Add song to playlist dialog opens
